summary_zh: 本页为绘本《老虎》的封面，展示了一只在水中休息的老虎，配有书名、作者、译者及出版社信息。

page_text_ocr_zh:
一只老虎！
A tiger!
这只老虎走在潮湿的丛林里，因为脚掌
上有厚厚的肉垫，它走起路来静悄悄的。它
饿极了！水牛，快藏好！野猪，小心点！
She prowls the steamy jungle on padded
paws. This tiger is hungry. Stay hidden,
buffalo. Watch out, wild pigs.
page_text_en:
A tiger!
A tiger!
This tiger walks through the damp jungle. Because its paws have thick pads, it walks quietly. It is very hungry! Buffalo, hide! Wild pigs, be careful!
She prowls the steamy jungle on padded paws. This tiger is hungry. Stay hidden, buffalo. Watch out, wild pigs.
summary_zh: 本页展示了一只在潮湿丛林中行走的老虎，文字描述了它因脚掌有厚肉垫而行动悄无声息，并且非常饥饿，提醒水牛和野猪要小心。

page_text_ocr_zh:
老虎仔细地听着，观察着周围的动静。突然，它停了下来。它看到了什么？只见它悄悄地向前走去。接着，它猛地往前一扑！
The tiger listens. She watches. Suddenly, she stops. What does she see? Slowly, silently, she inches ahead, then bursts forward to pounce!
page_text_en:
The tiger listens carefully, observing the动静 around it. Suddenly, it stops. What does it see? It quietly moves forward. Then, it suddenly lunges forward!
The tiger listens. She watches. Suddenly, she stops. What does she see? Slowly, silently, she inches ahead, then bursts forward to pounce!
summary_zh: 本页描绘了老虎在丛林中潜行捕猎的场景，它仔细观察、突然停下，然后悄悄靠近并猛扑向前，展现了其捕猎时的专注与迅猛。

The tiger makes her way back to a secret spot where tiny babies wait.
手机淘宝扫一扫

Chase!
It dashes out of the forest, across a stream,
but the agile wild boar escapes.
She dodges trees and races through

The tiger makes her way back to a secret spot where tiny babies wait.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了老虎追捕野猪但未能成功，随后返回其秘密巢穴——虎窝，与等待它的小老虎们团聚的场景。

page_text_en:
Cuddle
A mother tiger takes good care of her cubs. If she wants to move one, she gently carries it by the back of its neck.
Tiger cubs are born with their eyes tightly closed. About 7 days later, their little eyes will open.
summary_zh: 本页展示了老虎妈妈与小老虎之间的亲密互动，介绍了虎妈妈如何通过咬住小老虎的脖颈来搬运它们，并补充了虎宝宝出生后眼睛睁开的时间。

page_text_ocr_zh:

虎宝宝可喜欢玩了。它们在闪闪发光的溪水中玩耍，还会用大大的、软软的虎掌相互打闹。

page_text_en:
Mother tiger licks her cubs. Her rough tongue keeps their fur clean.
Growing cubs love to play. They splash in a sparkling stream and bat one another with big, soft paws.
summary_zh: 本页展示了老虎妈妈舔舐小老虎以清洁其皮毛，以及小老虎在溪水中嬉戏玩耍的场景，体现了虎妈妈的照顾和虎宝宝的活泼天性。

page_text_ocr_zh:

Cubs watch their mother. Copying everything she does teaches them how to be grown-up tigers.
虎宝宝通过偷袭兄弟姐妹来练习捕猎。它们扑倒对方，在地上打滚，并发出低沉的吼叫声。

page_text_en:
Cubs are watching their mother.
They learn by copying her every move, slowly learning how to grow up.
Cubs watch their mother. Copying everything she does teaches them how to be grown-up tigers.
Cubs practice hunting by sneaking up on a brother or sister. They pounce, roll around on the ground, and growl to sound tough.
They practice hunting by sneaking up on a brother or sister. They pounce, roll around on the ground, and growl to sound tough.
summary_zh: 本页展示了虎宝宝通过观察妈妈和与兄弟姐妹嬉戏打闹来学习捕猎技能，体现了它们在成长过程中的学习与互动。

page_text_ocr_zh:
冷暖有别
Hot and Cold
生活在世界不同地区的老虎在外形上有些差别。在
炎热的亚洲南部地区，老虎有一身光滑的短毛。而在寒
冷的北部森林地带，老虎的毛更厚、更长。
Tigers living in different parts of the world look different
from each other. In the hot southern parts of Asia, tigers
have short, sleek fur. In the cool forests of the north,
tigers have longer, thicker fur.
page_text_en:
Hot and Cold
Tigers living in different parts of the world look different from each other. In the hot southern parts of Asia, tigers have short, sleek fur. In the cool forests of the north, tigers have longer, thicker fur.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了生活在不同气候地区的老虎在外形上的差异：热带地区的老虎毛短光滑，而寒冷地区的老虎毛更厚更长。

老虎的猎物经常虎口脱险，但老虎只要反复尝试，就会有成功的机会。

page_text_en:
Tigers are meat-eaters.
They are always on the lookout for prey, such as deer, buffalo, or wild pig, that could be their next meal.
A tiger’s prey is usually lucky and escapes.
But just often enough, a tiger gets lucky, too.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了老虎作为肉食动物的习性，说明其猎物包括鹿、水牛和野猪，并指出虽然猎物常能逃脱，但老虎通过反复尝试最终也能成功捕猎。

page_text_en:

Happy wandering, tiger. Stay strong and healthy!
summary_zh: 本页展示了一只老虎在浅水中行走的场景，配文鼓励老虎在野外自由生活并保持健康强壮。

page_text_ocr_zh:
老虎的“语言”
Tiger Talk
老虎会发出很多声音与同伴交流，比如吼叫声、咕噜声、嘶嘶声或轻快而友好的嚓嚓声。
Tigers communicate with others by roaring, grunting, hissing, or making a friendly, airy sound called a chuff.
就算不发出声音，老虎也能交流。当老虎竖起耳朵、尾巴高高翘起的时候，表示它很放松，对某个事物充满好奇。当它张开大嘴露出尖锐的牙齿，并把耳朵往后收时，表示它要发动攻击了。
Tigers also communicate without sound. When a tiger's ears stand up straight and its tail is held high, it is feeling relaxed and curious. When a tiger shows its teeth and lays back its ears, it is about to attack.
这只老虎心情愉快，对事物充满好奇。
开心的时候，你会怎样表达呢？

page_text_en:
Tiger's "Language"
Tiger Talk
Tigers make many sounds to communicate with others, such as roaring, grunting, hissing, or making a friendly, airy sound called a chuff.
Tigers also communicate without sound. When a tiger's ears stand up straight and its tail is held high, it is feeling relaxed and curious. When a tiger shows its teeth and lays back its ears, it is about to attack.
This tiger is happy and curious about things.
When you're happy, how do you express it?
This tiger has smelled another tiger nearby.
This tiger is starting to roar.
When you can't speak, how do you express that you're hungry?
This roaring tiger is very angry!
summary_zh: 本页介绍了老虎通过声音（如吼叫、咕噜声）和身体语言（如耳朵竖起、尾巴翘起、露齿）进行交流的方式，并通过图片和文字展示了老虎在不同情绪下的表现，同时引导儿童思考人类在类似情境下的表达方式。
